answer.reason: Exact fit of the three quartet bands to the full d5 octahedral matrices with 4E = 10B+5C.

scripts.name: d5.py
d5.py

steps.command: cd /tmp && D=$(mktemp -d) && cd $D && sed 's/for x in (q,p):/for x in (p,q):/' /dev/stdin > /dev/null; ls /tmp/tsbench-run-o3p_lij2 2>/dev/null | head; find /tmp -name d5.py 2>/dev/null
cd <SANDBOX_TMP>/tmp.08ajEaEhMw && sed -i 's/for x in (q,p):/for x in (p,q):/' d5.py && python3 d5.py

cd <SANDBOX_TMP>/tmp.08ajEaEhMw && cat >> d5.py << 'EOF'
def res2(x):
    L=levels(*x)
    return [L[1][0]-19180,L[2][0]-22130,10*x[1]+5*x[2]-23370]
s=least_squares(res2,[700,700,3200]);print(s.x,res2(s.x),levels(*s.x)[:6])
for st in ([1000,600,3500],[500,800,3000],[900,650,3300]):
    s=least_squares(res2,st);print(s.x,res2(s.x))
EOF
python3 d5.py 2>&1 | tail -4

cd <SANDBOX_TMP>/tmp.08ajEaEhMw && cat >> d5.py << 'EOF'
from scipy.optimize import minimize
f=lambda x: sum(r*r for r in res2(x))
s=minimize(f,[600,780,3100],method='Nelder-Mead',options={'xatol':0.01,'fatol':1e-4,'maxiter':4000});print(s.x,res2(s.x),levels(*s.x)[:6])
EOF
python3 d5.py 2>&1 | tail -1
